verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community hands-on note that multimodal support in Ollama's app 'works as expected', which suggests image-plus-text input works. No first-party docs describe vision-language models, image input in the API, or supported VLMs. Image generation (docs-22) is a different capability and is not credited. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of vision-language model support, a list of supported vision models, documented image input via CLI/REST/SDK, and detailed independent corroboration.
